about: Hourly and daily fees for Mawaqif public parking in Abu Dhabi.
note: Requirements read from the official Abu Dhabi Mobility page on the checked date. This is a fee page rather than a form, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: AED 3 per hour for premium (white and turquoise) spaces, 4 hours maximum
AED 2 per hour, or AED 15 for the whole day, for standard (black and turquoise) spaces, 24 hours maximum
timing: Charged 8:00 am to 12:00 midnight; free on Sundays and public holidays
channels: Cash, Darb app, rechargeable card, phone payment or Mawaqif payment machines
